read_aggregation: read a ScanNet aggregation JSON file and return object-to-segments and label-to-segments mappings
read_segmentation: read a ScanNet segmentation JSON file and return segment-to-vertices mapping with vertex count
extract_bbox: extract bounding boxes and point clouds for each instance from mesh vertices and segment data
read_label_mapping: read a tab-delimited label mapping CSV file and return a category-to-NYU40 ID dictionary
read_mesh_vertices_rgb: read a PLY mesh file and return XYZ and RGB values for each vertex
